ctx.title: Avengers: Doomsday Advance Bookings Open In India: Tickets Sell Out Fast As Marvel Fans Answer The Call
ctx.summary:
Avengers: Doomsday advance bookings are now open in India, with several shows filling up fast ahead of its theatrical release. 
 The post  Avengers: Doomsday Advance Bookings Open In India: Tickets Sell Out Fast As Marvel Fans Answer The Call  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The wait is finally over! Following unprecedented ticket bookings globally, Marvel Studios opened ticket bookings for Avengers: Doomsday at midnight in India.
The response has been phenomenal, with audiences rushing to secure tickets for what is shaping up to be one of the biggest cinematic events in movie history. This comes following a wave of excitement, mounting anticipation, and a social media movement led by Indian fans rallying behind #OpenDoomsdayBookings.
With just a month to go, the frenzy is already visible across the country. Shows are available from as early as 12:01 AM to the last show at 11:55 PM, with screenings scheduled throughout the day. Several shows are already filling up fast and sold out across key markets, including Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi, Hyderabad and Kochi, among others. And now that the bookings are open, the message is clear: Indian fans want to be among the first to witness their favourite super heroes back on the big screen, and the race for those first-day, first-show tickets is well and truly on!
The craze for Avengers: Doomsday is not limited to India. The film has reportedly crossed a staggering $150 million in worldwide advance ticket sales, underlining the extraordinary anticipation surrounding its release. Its premium-format presales alone generated an impressive $16.5 million within the first 24 hours.
Adding to the global buzz, the film’s first full-length trailer clocked an extraordinary 503 million views in its first 24 hours, making it the second-biggest movie trailer launch in history. The film has also reportedly set presales milestones in international markets, including the UK and Brazil. Trade projections suggest a potential $1 billion -plus opening weekend, putting it in contention for an all-time global box office record.
India, meanwhile, added its own chapter to this global phenomenon. From fans taking to social media to demand the opening of advance bookings to audiences eagerly waiting to grab the best seats, the anticipation has been building for weeks. And there’s another reason to make the occasion even more special: Indian audiences will get to experience Avengers: Doomsday a day before the US release.
Arriving in cinemas on 17th December, a day ahead of its US release, Avengers: Doomsday will release in English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu, across Marvel Studios Presented In Infinity Vision and other premium formats.
